title: Build TodoInput component
description:
Create the TodoInput component that provides a text input field for adding new todos. The input should be visible at the top of the app. Pressing Enter or clicking a submit button calls the onAdd callback with the trimmed text. After successful submission, the input field clears. Empty or whitespace-only input is rejected — no submission occurs. Use shadcn/ui Input and Button components styled with Tailwind CSS.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Section 5.1

functional: Text input field is visible at the top of the app
Pressing Enter submits the todo text
Clicking the submit button submits the todo text
Input field clears after successful submission
onAdd callback receives the trimmed text value
edge_cases: Empty input does not trigger submission
Whitespace-only input does not trigger submission
Very long text remains usable in the input field

testing_requirements.target: Enter key triggers submission with trimmed text
